purpose: Fresh pod-creation registry for the runpod-pod-creation skill. Used when a pod cannot be started and RunPod manual migration fails (no available GPU). Fresh pods start with an EMPTY local volume, so each entry carries from-scratch provisioning steps (model re-download).
notes: B-101 (2026-08-27): Serverless migration IN PROGRESS. Plan: specs/Planning/B-101-serverless-migration/plan.md. Serverless endpoint registry + scaffold: helpers/runpod/serverless/ (README.md, endpoints.json, worker Dockerfiles/handlers, create-endpoint/smoke-test/build-on-pod helpers). Migration order: DWPose (infra proof) -> Juggernaut -> identity -> Qwen VL -> Qwen Edit. Pods are STOPPED-NOT-DELETED as rollback until each endpoint soaks green; deprovision (and this note) only after cutover.

B-101 QWEN EDIT MODEL DECISION (2026-08-28): the stock qwen_image_edit_2511_fp8mixed.safetensors is safety-aligned (breasts render, genital region blanks to a 'mannequin'). Pod-side fix with Scottzilla MCNL v1 NSFW LoRA FAILED proof (anatomy confusion - both figures got female anatomy); the LoRA-on-fp8-UNET path is dead. The serverless qwen-edit-worker MUST use the merged checkpoint Phr00t/Qwen-Image-Edit-Rapid-AIO-NSFW-v23 (26.48 GB FP8, ungated at huggingface.co/Phr00t/Qwen-Image-Edit-Rapid-AIO/resolve/main/v23/Qwen-Rapid-AIO-NSFW-v23.safetensors; SFW sibling Qwen-Rapid-AIO-SFW-v23.safetensors). No runtime LoRA needed (LoRAs baked). Requires CheckpointLoaderSimple workflow (not UNETLoader split) + ~4-8 steps / 1 CFG / euler_ancestral/beta. GGUF NVFP4 variants are a dead end (need Blackwell/CUDA 13+). Full detail in the B-101 plan.md MODEL DECISION block.

There is no RunPod REST availability endpoint. create-pod.ps1 passes candidateGpuTypeIds in order with gpuTypePriority=custom; RunPod rents the FIRST GPU with current capacity. Cheapest-first ordering implements the 'cheaper when it still supports the workflow and is not too slow' policy.

SECURE cloud = on-demand reserved (no preemption, guaranteed public IP, SSH TCP works). COMMUNITY cloud = cheaper spot capacity but preemptible and no public-IP guarantee; only use if the manifest tooling (SSH, proxy) is confirmed to work there.
Fresh pod = empty /workspace. Every pod below re-downloads its models via its provision script. Model download size is noted per pod.

Cloud compatibility: create-pod.ps1 filters candidates by the requested cloud. NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 Ti is COMMUNITY-ONLY (secureCloud=false) and is auto-dropped on SECURE. NVIDIA A40 and RTX PRO 4500 are SECURE-only in this catalog.
